skills.name: privco-mcp-search
skills.description: Use the PrivCo MCP tools (`mcp__privco-data-mcp__*`) correctly for company / people / funding queries. Covers the non-obvious filter semantics (full state name, industry vs keyword, sorting enum, summary-row gaps, includeMissing), the standard match → profile → vc_deals workflow, and the two-stage pattern for "top N by valuation". Activate when the user wants to search/filter PrivCo data, look up a specific company, or build a multi-entity dataset. Trigger phrases: "find companies that…", "search PrivCo for…", "who are the X companies in Y", "look up <company> in PrivCo", "valuations for…", "build a fixture / dataset of companies matching…".
headings: 3. `inclusionExclusion` is a requirement, not an addition
6. `keyword.condition` is required whenever `keyword` filter is used
9. `deal_search` sort default depends on whether `query` is set
D. Recent funding ("raised >X in year Y")
skills.description_zh: 指导正确使用 PrivCo MCP 查询公司、人员及融资数据，解释完整州名、行业与关键词、排序枚举、摘要缺项和 includeMissing 的过滤含义；采用匹配→档案→融资交易流程，并用两阶段方法查询估值前 N 名。
